labour_split.source: Mona Lisa 'Input Tabs' actual FOH/BOH block (pipe 1).
labour_split.note: 'absent' = the site filed no actual FOH/BOH split on any trading day of the week - NOT a failed validation and NOT a zero. 'filed' = it filed something; this pipe does not reconstruct or validate the split (rows are shifted in that tab), so 'filed' is not a validated 'ok'.

efficiency_score.scale: 0–100, 100 = at target; bands: green ≥95, amber ≥80, red <80
efficiency_score.formula_ref: control_centre efficiencyScore() v3 — SPH 15% (level vs per-format target + WoW momentum); each component hard-capped at 100; Lifetime★ excluded

red_light.basis: computed from the dashboard's own KPIs (sales vs target ≤ -10%, wage > 26%, food > 25%); no external pull

negative_reviews.author: Cheung Helen
negative_reviews.text:
Extremely overpriced (much more expensive than London yet the portion is smaller)
Ordered grilled sushi set and the sushi are tiny. Miso soup and seaweed salad are massive rip off too. Spent extra on nigri as the portion was too small. Imagine spending £40+ in total but still felt hungry…?

reviews.source: Google Reviews workbook 1aFGfbGr... 'Raw Data' tab (gid 284143046), full-history rows deduped on reviewId, filtered by review RECEIVED date to 2026-08-31..2026-09-06 (Mon-Sun). Per-site star tabs NOT used (corrupt). Daily Pipe 8b feed NOT used for counts (its reviews[] caps positives at 12/site and drops comment-less reviews). negative_reviews = rating<=3 with a non-empty comment; `negatives` counts ALL rating<=3 including those with no comment. url null (not in source). Cumulative venue rating not in this source (null). Built 2026-09-08.
